skills.description: Create short videos by transferring a reference video's motion/actions onto the person(s) in a photo — "让照片里的人做出视频里的动作". Takes a photo (the subject) plus a reference video (the motion source), analyzes the video's actions, then generates a new video where the photo's subject performs those actions. Supports full-body dance/sports and multi-person choreography. Use when the user provides (or wants to provide) a photo + a video and asks to: make the person in the photo do the actions/dance/movements from the video; transfer motion from a video to a photo; 让照片里的人做视频里的动作; 照片+视频生成视频; 动作迁移/动作模仿; 换人跳舞; 模仿视频动作; motion transfer; video reenactment; photo-to-video with reference motion. Also triggers on "用这张照片模仿这段视频的动作" or similar.
skills.name: 图片ai视频生成
